assumptions: Pure clean water; fixed 100 LMH reference flux and 1 m2 area inherited from the verified graded-support study.
Recovery is permeate/feed mass fraction, equivalently volumetric recovery at the common feed reference density. Actual flashed volumetric flows are reported separately.
All feed is pressurized. Two nonempty product streams discharge at the fresh-feed pressure, without energy recovery or recycle.
The membrane uses a stock splitter and an isenthalpic pressure-loss valve on the permeate branch; no solute rejection or intrinsic membrane unit is claimed.
A separate upstream stock valve represents a lumped channel loss. Zero and 20 kPa are sensitivity assumptions, not measured channel hydraulics or axial pressure profiles.
Julia supplies TMP from the unchanged fixed-impedance scenario and native OpenLB resistance ratios. DWSIM supplies water properties, flashes, stream balances and pump work.
No fouling, osmosis, electrical motor loss, backwash, pressure recovery, crossflow recycle or total-plant energy prediction.
